children: announced a new feature that it says will make selling on its app even easier. Using what it calls next-generation magical listing technology, eBay (BEAY) said it is leveraging AI to transform its customers' photos into a ready-to-review listing.

The selling process has been simplified so that after users take photos of their item, eBay automatically identifies it and fills in the listing details. The seller then reviews the draft lifting and hits publish. The company noted that more than 10M unique sellers have used eBay’s
AI features to date, creating more than 800K new listings every day.

"By shifting the work from setup to review, eBay’s new listing experience eliminates manual data entry and takes the guesswork out of selling. While AI powers the creation, you remain completely in control. Nothing goes live without your approval: you can easily review the pre-filled information, make any edits, and decide exactly when your item is ready to list," updated eBay
The new camera-first listing experience is available to sellers in Australia, France, Germany, Italy, the U.K., and the U.S.

title: eBay is letting AI do the heavy lifting for sellers on the site
